review_description: i recently needed assistance with my solar ,that was installed by another company,  i contacted Cameron and he went out of his way to help me out.i was very impressed with his professional approach and the genuine concern he displayed, a breath of fresh air in an industry plagued by problems , thanks again.

This company did not send required paperwork to Ergon Energy to have the solar meter installed. I have been trying to contact them since September 2018 with no response!!I am now going to the ACCC to try to rectify this as I now have an $1800 bill !!!I got solar to have cheaper bills not double because of incorrect meter!!
a good company to deal with, very professional
